visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty one: is your son available (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js playroom (mint walls, a window, a flag garland, a striped round rug, a crib with a baby who sits up crying, a playpen, a toy box, blocks, a teddy, stacking rings), a desk with a laptop nap timer, a phone on a tiny tripod with a blinking REC dot and a baby monitor, a clapperboard that snaps for each take, a box-built dog that barks, a toddler who walks in holding the product and later wears sunglasses, box-built mum with a bun and a pink cardigan, phone sheets for the brand chat / the brief / the content bank, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.6 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a mom of two gets one nap, twenty minutes, to film. Take one: the doorbell. Take two: the dog. Take three: her son walks in holding the product. The brand wants B-roll and a screen recording, the nap is over, and she ends up sitting in the playpen. Then YourBrand: her brief comes with a content bank, the clips and screen recordings ready, so she only films her part: one take, one nap. The brand loved it. They asked if her son is available.
